etkinlik.aciklama: Seminars, workshops, concerts, webinars or course open days: registration form, QR tickets and door check-in in one place.
etkinlik.aciklamaYonetici: Events of the agency and its clients. Paid tickets only for agency events; client events use free registration or a pay-at-the-door / bank transfer note.

durumAciklama.taslak: Draft: the page is closed and no registrations are taken.
durumAciklama.yayinda: Published: the page is open and registrations are accepted.
durumAciklama.iptal: Cancelled: registered attendees were notified; this cannot be undone.
durumAciklama.tamamlandi: Completed: the event is over; the thank-you email is sent if enabled.

liste.yeniAciklama: A name and time are enough; edit the details later. A free "Standard" ticket type is added automatically.

alan.iptalSinir: Attendee cancellation: up to how many hours before the start
alan.katilimciAdlari: Ask for an attendee name per ticket
alan.listedeGoster: Show on the account's event list

ipucu.ozet: Shown in link previews and lists (max. 300 characters).
ipucu.markdown: Simple formatting like bold, lists and links is supported; HTML is ignored.
ipucu.online: Shown only to valid ticket holders (ticket page and email).
ipucu.oturumlar: For multi-day / multi-session events; each is added separately to the calendar file.
ipucu.kayitKapanis: If empty, closes when the event starts.
ipucu.odemeNotuAjans: Paid tickets get a payment link automatically; you can add a bank transfer / pay-at-the-door note here.
ipucu.odemeNotu: No payments are collected through this panel: write pay-at-the-door or bank transfer details here; they appear on the registration page.
ipucu.kvkk: If empty, a short default notice is shown.

ayar.iptalOnay: Cancel the event? Registered attendees receive a cancellation email; paid tickets are marked "refund pending". This cannot be undone.
ayar.silOnay: Move the event to the trash?

bilet.ucretsizNot: Tickets for client events are free; payments go to the agency's account, so no money is collected through this panel. Write pay-at-the-door or bank transfer details in Settings › Payment information.
bilet.fiyatIpucu: 0 = free. Payment is taken via the agency's payment provider.
bilet.odemeHazirDegil: Paid tickets are disabled because no payment provider keys (Lemon Squeezy or Shopier) are configured. They become available once the keys are set on the server.
bilet.kontenjanIpucu: If empty, only the event capacity applies.
bilet.gizliTur: Hidden type (visible only with a code)

indirim.aciklama: Percentage or fixed-amount discount on paid tickets; usage limit and expiry are optional.

katilimci.iptalOnay: Cancel the ticket? The seat is released and the waitlist may be invited.

bekleme.aciklama: When a seat opens, the next people in line get an invitation link valid for 24 hours.

giris.aciklama: Events you may scan for. You don't see attendee data; you only scan tickets.

kapi.okutAciklama: Full-screen scanner for phones: scans the QR with the camera when supported, otherwise you type the code. The last 50 scans are kept even if the connection drops.
kapi.elleIpucu: The 10-character code on the ticket or the QR content
kapi.gorevliAciklama: Door staff can scan tickets without logging in — nothing else. The link stops working when it expires or is renewed.
kapi.varsayilanSure: Until 12 hours after the event ends
kapi.gorevliYenileOnay: Invalidate all previously shared staff links?
kapi.gorevliYenilendi: Old links revoked; a new link is ready

satis.ucretsiz: This event has no paid tickets; the figures below are registration counts.
satis.ucretsizMusteri: Client events have no paid tickets (payments go to the agency's account); the figures below are registration counts.

iletisim.duyuruAciklama: Information for valid ticket holders only (time / venue change, reminder). Don't use it for ads or campaigns — use Email marketing for that.
iletisim.duyuruOnay: Send the announcement to all valid ticket holders?
iletisim.tesekkurAciklama: A few hours after the event ends, attendees get a one-time thank-you email (scheduled task). You can add a survey link.
iletisim.tesekkurMetniIpucu: If empty, a short default text is used.
iletisim.pazarlamaAciklama: Only attendees who explicitly gave marketing consent at registration are added to the selected list.
iletisim.pazarlamaKapali: The email marketing module is off for this account.
iletisim.listeYok: Create a list in Email marketing first.

paylas.yayindaDegil: The event isn't published; the link opens once it is.
paylas.qrAlt: QR code of the event page
paylas.qrIpucu: Use it on posters and flyers; it opens the event page.
paylas.gommeAciklama: Show the registration form on your own site. Paste the code into your page; the height adjusts automatically.
paylas.listeAciklama: Lists the account's published events on one page (those with "show on list" on).
paylas.listeIpucu: Address: /etkinlikler/<slug>. While off, the page returns "not found".

hata.genel: Something went wrong. Please try again.
hata.ag: Could not connect. Check your internet connection.
hata.cok_hizli: Too many requests; please wait a few seconds.
hata.baglanti_gecersiz: The link must start with https://.
hata.slug_gecersiz: The address may only contain lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (3–50 characters).
hata.slug_ayrilmis: This address is reserved; choose another.
hata.slug_dolu: This address is taken; choose another.
hata.bitis_once: The end must be after the start.
hata.sure_uzun: An event can last at most 62 days.
hata.kapanis_sonra: Registration can't close after the event ends.
hata.acilis_sonra: Registration must open before it closes.
hata.oturum_araligi: Sessions must be within the event time.
hata.secenek_tekrar: Options must be different from each other.
hata.aralik_disi: The value is out of range.
hata.kapasite_siniri: Capacity can be at most {{sinir}} (module limit).
hata.kapasite_az: Capacity can't be lower than current registrations ({{en_az}}).
hata.kontenjan_az: The quota can't be lower than current registrations ({{en_az}}).
hata.aylik_etkinlik_siniri: This month's event limit ({{sinir}}) has been reached.
hata.bilet_turu_yok: At least one active ticket type is needed to publish.
hata.online_baglanti_gerekli: Online or hybrid events need an online link.
hata.iptal_geri_alinamaz: A cancelled event can't be reopened.
hata.ucretli_bilet_yalniz_ajans: Paid tickets are only available for agency events; for client events, write the payment details as text.
hata.odeme_saglayicisi_yok: No payment provider keys are configured; paid tickets can't be enabled.
hata.para_birimi_farkli: Paid ticket types must use the same currency.
hata.para_birimi_karisik: Tickets in different currencies can't be in one order.
hata.gizli_kod_gerekli: Enter a code for the hidden type.
hata.satis_araligi: Sales must end after they start.
hata.tur_siniri: At most {{sinir}} ticket types can be added.
hata.bilet_var: This type has {{sayi}} registrations; take it off sale instead of deleting.
hata.kod_gecersiz: The code must be 3–40 characters: letters, digits, hyphens and underscores only.
hata.indirim_siniri: At most {{sinir}} discount codes can be added.
hata.katilimci_var: Can't delete while there are {{sayi}} active registrations; cancel the event first.
hata.tur_dolu: This ticket type is sold out.
hata.kisi_basi_siniri: At most {{en_cok}} tickets of this type per person.
hata.katilimci_adi_gerekli: An attendee name is required for each ticket.
hata.alici_yok: No attendees with a valid ticket.
hata.modul_kapali: This module is off for the account.
hata.kisi_siniri: The email marketing contact limit would be exceeded.
hata.depo_hatasi: The image could not be stored; try again shortly.
hata.gorsel_gecersiz: The image could not be read.
hata.gorsel_buyuk: The image file is too large.
hata.gorsel_boyutu: The image dimensions are not suitable.
